name: warm-watch
description: Tells you before a chat's prompt cache goes cold, on your desktop or phone, with Keep warm and Compact now buttons, and can compact big idle chats while they are still warm so a rebuild costs a fraction.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before cold
warnMinutes.description: How long before the cache is expected to go cold the notification fires.

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: 60 on a Claude subscription; 5 on API keys unless promptCacheTtl is 1h.

minContextTokens.title: Only warn above this context size
minContextTokens.description: Small conversations are cheap to re-cache, so they get no warning.

compactWhenIdle.title: Compact big chats when idle
compactWhenIdle.description: Compact a chat above the size below after it has been idle this long, while its cache is still warm: the next rebuild then writes only the short summary. off by default, since a summary keeps the plan and decisions, not every detail.

compactAbove.title: Compact chats above (tokens)
compactAbove.description: Only chats at least this big are compacted when idle.
